We've got your back when it comes to defective items! Our Lifetime Warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal use. 🎉

Here's what's covered:

Hinge or spring failure
Frame assembly or finish defects
Lens coating defects: This includes mirror or color coating that's peeling, flaking, or bubbling, or lens delamination (where the lens layers separate or a hazy film forms between them).

It's important to note that the warranty does not cover scratches or scuffs from everyday use, accidental damage (like sitting on them or dropping them), loss, theft, counterfeit goods, purchases from unauthorized sellers, complimentary/promotional pairs, or international orders.

If you believe your sunglasses have a manufacturing defect, here's how to start a claim:

Open our Returns & Warranty Portal and enter your order number and email.
Select the defect reason and upload clear photos of the issue.
If your claim is approved, you'll receive store credit equal to your original purchase price to choose a new pair.

Remember, it's one warranty claim per paid pair, and an order number or proof of purchase is required. If you bought your shades from an authorized retailer, you'll need to send a copy of your receipt, your shipping address, and photos of the defect, the front of the frame, and the inside of the arm showing the style through our Contact Form. 🤝

For all the details, you can check out our full Lifetime Warranty policy. 💡
